description:
Board buddy is a free, open source companion for board game nights. Track scores, counters, turns, rules, and key moments without reaching for paper or losing the flow of the game.

Use dedicated helpers for popular tabletop and card games, or start a flexible counter for any game at the table. Board buddy keeps the score clear so everyone can focus on the match, the strategy, and the people playing.

No ads, no hidden purchases, just a practical scorekeeper for board games.
promotionalText: Track scores, counters, turns, and rules for board game night. Free, open source, and built for the table.
